name: project-pn-dev
install: npm install && go -C backend mod download
start: sudo service docker start; test -f backend/.env || cp backend/.env.example backend/.env; test -f frontend/.env || cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env; docker compose -f backend/compose.yaml --env-file backend/.env up -d

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd backend && set -a && source .env && set +a && go run ./cmd/api
terminals.description: Go API on :8080 (requires Postgres from start)
